ad_html:
Advertisement

Fieldwork

A real project for your university application.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship for school students, built around a live environmental project near home. Students also join research conversations with professors from universities such as MIT, Oxford and Cambridge, and their work is verified.

Learn more at earth5r.org
jobs_ad_html: Fieldwork For students, and for teachers to pass along: FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship where school students work on a live environmental project near home and join research conversations with professors from MIT, Oxford, Cambridge and LSE. Their work is verified. earth5r.org/fieldwork
